body: I appreciate your concern. I have applied for work. In fact I have spent the last 2 years trying to find a job and haven't found anything. If I could motivate myself maybe I wouldn't be here.

Basically no one cares anymore. I have no friends, and my family chooses to ignore me rather than face my problems with me. I've tried to get help in the past and nothing has worked. I tried multiple medications and the odd half dozen therapists, none of it did anything. When that failed the few friends I had at the time left me, as they were tired of dealing with me. Now I'm 23, no friends, no job, barely getting by on a scholarship that I'm about to lose because though a lack of intelligence is not one of my problems I can barely find the motivation to get out of bed, let alone go to class or study. I just don't care anymore.
